item.title: From Messi chaos in Kolkata to Bengaluru stampede: How Opposition-run states keep proving they consistently fail at the most basic functions of governance
item.description: Whether it was the disorder that engulfed Lionel Messi’s GOAT Tour stop in Kolkata or the deadly stampede during RCB’s victory celebrations in Bengaluru earlier this year, the message is unmistakable: opposition parties consistently fail at the most basic function of governance—maintaining law and order.

item.title: Arunachal Tragedy: Death of 21 workers in truck accident came to light 2 days later when lone survivor reached a BRO camp, contractor Sirajul Ahmed arrested
item.description: The local authorities came to know about the accident two days later when the lone survivor managed to climb up and reach a a Border Roads Task Force (BRTF) camp.

item.title: Meet R Sreelekha, Kerala’s first female IPS officer, who is likely to be BJP’s mayor in Thiruvananthapuram
item.description: During her tenure with the CBI, R Sreelekha gained a reputation as “Raid Sreelekha” for her no-nonsense approach to combating corruption and fearlessness in conducting investigations.

item.title: Bahraich violence: Shot at close range, body riddled with 40 wounds, toes burnt; court awards death penalty in Ram Gopal Mishra murder case – Read what the judgment says
item.description: Eyewitness testimony, forensic evidence, and recovery of the licensed gun established close-range firing and extreme cruelty. The judgment ruled that alleged provocation offered no defence, underscoring that law provides remedies, not licence for violent retaliation.

item.title: Dynamic young leader with organisational and administrative experience: All you need to know about BJP’s new working president Nitin Nabin
item.description: PM Modi congratulated Nabin Nitin on the appointment, saying that he has distinguished himself as a hardworking Karyakarta.

item.title: Bondi Beach Hanukkah terror attack: Sajid Akram and Naveed Akram named as terrorists behind antisemitic massacre; ISIS links emerged – What we know so far
item.description: Police say the father and son of Pakistani origin, Naveed Akram and Sajid Akram, used legally owned weapons at a crowded Jewish celebration, while investigators probe intelligence gaps, IS symbolism, explosive threats, and whether existing counter terrorism frameworks failed to prevent one of Australia’s deadliest attacks.

item.title: PM Modi starts 3-nation tour to Jordan, Oman and Ethiopia: Read how India’s relations with these nations underscore business, credibility and co-operation
item.description: When taken as a whole, the tour portrays an India that is building coalitions, corridors, and capabilities rather than chasing headlines, reducing the risk of trade routes, expanding strategic options in West Asia and the western Indian Ocean, and maintaining the credibility of India's development-first diplomacy in a world of sharper blocs and precarious supply lines.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Pastor offered money, free education for children and medical facilities to Hindus for converting to Christianity in Mirzapur; 5 arrested – Exclusive FIR details
item.description: The FIR states Dubey was lured inside the church, renamed during the ritual and nearly taken away for conversion. He fled and alerted police,.Intelligence inputs warned of large scale religious conversions planned ahead of Christmas.

item.title: Vice President issues postage stamp for Perumbidugu Mutharaiyar II, the forgotten Tamil king Suvaran Maran who never lost a battle
item.description: Released within a month of a DMK minister’s appeal, the stamp highlights a seventh century ruler whose court hosted Jain and Shaiva scholars, whose victories spanned twelve locations, and whose administrative foresight shaped Tamil polity.

item.title: As the Left starts outraging over ‘name change’: Here is how the new VB G RAM G is a marked improvement on MGNREGA
item.description: The VB-G RAM G Bill 2025 focuses not only on generating rural employment but also on creating durable infrastructure.
